note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. There was no contest for any of the 16 seats (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8). Fifteen candidates were nominated and returned unopposed; they are recorded from the Mid-Ulster Mail's list of the nominations (21 May 1955, p. 9, page image read). The only newcomer was Robert Eccles, for Sandholes, in place of Major C. A. M. Alexander. No candidate was nominated for Killeenan, whose retiring member was Mr. Peter Malone; the paper expected the seat to be filled 'later on', and no 1955 source read names its member, so Killeenan is not recorded. No labels are printed. New member, in place of Major C. A. M. Alexander; the first meeting (Mid-Ulster Mail, 11 June 1955, p. 6) welcomed 'Mr. Robert A. Eccles, the new representative for the Electoral Division of Sandholes'. Returned unopposed.
